dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't Tatankasaurs supposed to be fierce?

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: Not in the slightest! Unless someone wicked tries to hurt one on purpose, Tatankasaurs very rarely lose their temper.

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: And even when they do get angry, they never hurt people. The most one will do is butt you lightly with its head... Despite the fact they're strong enough to crack rock.

dialogues.speaker: Nappa
dialogues.text: The point is, Tatankasaurs are really just gentle babies.
